milestone.objective: Establish one coherent, uncertainty-aware whole-chip model that demonstrates several credible ways for the transceiver to succeed.
milestone.outcome: Architectural confidence and actionable circuit requirements, not a claim that fabricated silicon will work.

criteria.current_gap: All 17 interfaces map six requirement dimensions. Derived FPGA rate envelopes now distinguish bulk capacity from conditional queue bounds and unsupported direct RF tuning. criteria.acceptance: One selected composition exercises startup, operation, legal mode changes, faults and recovery with finite transport and persistent analog state.
criteria.current_gap: One retained RF/wired/USB trajectory uses inventory local/HOST loads, package state, SAR switch loading and cycle guard. Paired asynchronous decisions run under explicit50ps regeneration/100ps launch/200mV threshold assumptions with20ns publication and3ns acquisition. Model-derived reference/supply observations gate startup and expire after200ns; independent100ns observations cover idle periods. Stopped zero, +/-VREF/4 and normal selections deliver110 complete pairs each with assigned diagnostic reference charge. criteria.acceptance: Bound shared power, package and timing uncertainties together, including adverse combinations and interior resonances; distinguish assigned ranges from justified bounds.
criteria.current_gap: RF RX/TX230mA, wired268.45mA and USB252.2mA use one inventory/package catalog with retained local/HOST transitions and matching DC rails. Traffic-dependent converter/DAC/core switching feedback and physical capture delay remain incomplete. The selected CDR has scoped acquired-state and nominal-local-clock cold successes under the shared supply/channel model; source-loss recovery and the full coupled uncertainty envelope remain open. Current CDR evidence is recorded in selected-revision-check.json with its original source fingerprints; these sampled successes are not physical bounds. Combined converter loading/noise/reference-drive and asynchronous timing have a conditional success region with little margin, not continuous uncertainty or rare-event coverage. Shared-pad charge injection and finite power cycles retain external drive; modeled rail clamps backfeed83..84mA, while the ground-primary topology omits that path. Physical junction/stress limits, automatic brownout isolation, floating-supply response and clamp-current package coupling remain open. The first RF-chain matrix now demonstrates sampled wideband and narrowband regions with coupled noise, blockers, delivered phase, finite gain settling, clipping, asynchronous conversion/reference feedback and loaded TX distortion on the selected234mA/package inventory. This is diagnostic BPSK/LE1M evidence only. Continuous uncertainty coverage, valid HE training/higher modulation, emissions, signal-dependent RF current closure and physical realization remain open.

Assigned input envelope and ordered-clock sufficient bounds also pass. Endpoints and wired timing pass the rail interval, with wired lower bound 2.564605 V.

adc_switching_uncertainty.allocation: CORE 40 mA includes existing 20 mA pulses plus 2 mA reference idle and 1 mA recharge-limit reserve; at most 17 mA remains for the investigated missing ADC activity. Mean replaces steady current, not additional chip DC.
adc_switching_uncertainty.hypotheses: 22 equal-charge I/Q-pair acquisition, bit-settle, comparator and reset events at existing SAR schedule. Fast-rate means 5/10/17 mA, gamma pulse tau 0.2/0.5/1 ns; LO /64 and /256. Compare fixed charge per conversion against constant-mean low-rate stress.
adc_switching_uncertainty.result: All 54 fixed-charge finite-tone rail screens fit the assigned interval across RF endpoints and 2426 MHz; lowest lower enclosure 2.582359 V. Constant 17 mA at /256 loses the sufficient lower-rail enclosure for all three pulse widths; it assumes four times the fast-rate charge per conversion.
adc_switching_uncertainty.decision: Use explicit charge-per-conversion and idle-current hypotheses for rate scaling. Retain constant-mean slow-rate cases as stress controls, not predicted ADC behavior.
adc_switching_uncertainty.limits: Arbitrary-origin finite 128-harmonic rail/input/edge enclosure under selected mismatch, delay sensitivity and current hypotheses. Switching charge, waveform shape, omitted harmonics, code dependence and physical current remain unknown. Reference-recharge AC, lifecycle forcing and actual RF/wired payload under the added switching spectra remain unjoined.
adc_switching_uncertainty.clock_result: All 54 fixed-charge cases retain the 0.6 V input-leg envelope (worst bound 0.429063 V), unique rising-edge sufficient inequalities at 20 and 35 mV thresholds, and monotonic downstream delay mapping. Worst deterministic displacement bound is 19.2707 ps at 35 mV; not RMS jitter, phase noise, BER or EVM.

package_handover_screen.next_action: Keep 100 ns as a provisional ramp, not a qualified requirement. Join clock/activity switching and converter-current forcing to the persistent network; ramp sweeps alone do not address the remaining 56 mV margin.
package_handover_screen.persistent_verification: Independent Radau integration and split-interval invariance pass in test_baseline_envelope. All nine selected_lifecycle package ramp cases now execute the persistent interface and agree with batch state-space integration.
package_handover_screen.scheduled_transition_semantics: LocalLoadTransient.ramp_to schedules finite current ramps with automatic slope removal at completion. Replacing a pending ramp starts from the reached current and retains capacitor/inductor state; interrupted recovery and subsequent restart are checked. All nine package screens now use scheduled ramps and still match batch integration.
package_handover_screen.quasistationary_screen: Phase-evidence hashes verified before reuse. Subtract each mode DC from its source-wise ripple interval, then add the union ripple interval to one continuous load-ramp trace. Selected 0.25 nH gives [2.556238,3.179216] V for all tested 20 ns/100 ns/1 us ramps; 0.5 nH gives [2.537405,3.192901] V. Adverse package fails. Only 56 mV of selected lower-bound margin remains under this approximation.

ownership_package_trace.demonstrated: One selected lifecycle joins RF RX/TX and wired duplex through startup, STOP/rearm, reference loss and recovery. RX includes shared antenna-level frontend/filter/SAR and actual 10-bit-host-word reconstruction. TX includes actual consumed words, DAC/filter, mixer and resistive output port. Nominal wideband mode scales before packing; unscaled diagnostic mode retains output overload as a negative control.
ownership_package_trace.assumptions: Warm package, discharged SAR, ideal upstream 1 V reference, parked ADC outside RX, assigned current ramps and guarded model-observed readiness. Fixed gain, ideal frame boundaries/known DATA training and ideal mute remain assumptions; this is not physical READY or packet acceptance.
ownership_package_trace.gap: Shared physically bounded source/load/timing uncertainties, converter-current feedback, TX reference draw, real acquisition/fast turnaround, cold startup, physical mute transients and per-capability acceptance remain open.
ownership_package_trace.timing_observer: Persistent package now includes a continuous one-pole supply-delay state using contract 1 GHz pole and 0.025 ps/mV sensitivity. Independent ODE check passes and slope changes preserve filtered timing state. Wired-mode settled incremental delay is -2.756 ps relative to warm RF baseline; signed static shift is not RMS jitter.
ownership_package_trace.preview_semantics: Finite clock callbacks now bind to the package load-generation counter as well as the chip stream epoch. New ramp/slope commands invalidate prior callbacks; automatic completion of an already scheduled ramp does not. Negative/out-of-range indices reject. The caller must stop/rebind before changing loads while a transport queue contains cached events; in-transfer load changes remain unsupported.

Duty cycle and code statistics differ by fixture; whole-trace mean is not continuous power. TX DAC load and package feedback remain absent.

switching_load_handover.demonstrated: A settled RF periodic network state continues through a 100 ns half-cosine crossfade of 64-harmonic timing/core spectra and the allocated 52 mA mode-load increase. Piecewise-linear prescribed current is tracked to below 2e-15 A at knots; capacitor/inductor state is not reset.
switching_load_handover.result: With analytical instantaneous slew in the voltage observer, 25/12.5 ps difference is 73.115 uV and 12.5/6.25 ps difference is 18.262 uV. Finest sampled smooth-source rail interval [2.663623,3.073756] V. Raw piecewise-linear voltage comparisons (17.162 and 8.949 mV) are retained, not relabeled as circuit-state error.
switching_load_handover.limits: Reduced local-current port only. Host and differential-clock forcing, converter loads, phase corners, board tolerance, physical activity sequencing and between-sample bounds remain absent. Do not replace the full periodic-plus-transition gate with this trace.
switching_load_handover.next_action: Join host/clock and converter forcing to this continuous trajectory. Numerical smooth-source observation is sufficiently stable for that integration; final between-sample/physical validity remains open.
switching_load_handover.numerical_interpretation: y=Cx+D*dI/dt contains direct inductive feedthrough. Numerical state follows piecewise-linear current exactly at knots; observer substitutes the known smooth derivative only in D. Fourfold error reduction supports second-order state convergence, not a rigorous continuous-time error bound.

full_package_transient.demonstrated: 18-variable MNA descriptor includes all seven full-network nodes, nine branch currents, two series-capacitor voltages, split returns, mutual inductance, coupling capacitance and independent reference legs. 459 frequency cases match existing node solution within 2.68e-10 V. Six sinusoidal transient cases at 1 MHz/2.426 GHz across three packages refine with 128/256 steps per period.
full_package_transient.scope: Trapezoidal DAE with finite-slew input interpolation and caller-supplied consistent initial state. Singular storage matrix is not inverted. Four-cycle sinusoidal checks do not qualify abrupt activity changes, stiff numerical ringing, startup or arbitrary initial states.
full_package_transient.next_action: Full-network prescribed transition is now recorded below. Next join converter forcing and actual stop/retune/restart source sequencing, retaining phase/package uncertainty and numerical refinement.

full_package_handover.demonstrated: One stored full-network state receives host/internal/reference and 52 mA DC load forcing. Reference and LO-derived timing/D2H ramp down over 20 ns, remain off for 100 ns, then ramp up over 20 ns at the wired rate. H2D/core remain active. All envelopes are prescribed stimuli.
full_package_handover.result: 6.25 ps sampled rail [2.615506,3.139110] V, input-leg peaks [0.251901,0.392777] V; 12.5/6.25 ps maximum node difference 1.761 mV. Effective clock input peaks at 17.002 mV within the 240–300 ns source-off observation window; zero sampled upward crossings of assigned 20 mV threshold.
full_package_handover.limits: Only about 3 mV nominal source-off threshold margin; no threshold offset/noise/phase/package sweep, continuous-time crossing enclosure or live digital monitor qualification. One nominal board-voltage trajectory. Stop/restart ramps are not measured or qualified external-source behavior. No converter feedback, payload recovery or cold-start/fault qualification.
full_package_handover.decision: Keep package hypothesis. Prioritize false clock-presence rejection under continuing H2D/core activity before claiming reliable source-loss detection or restart.
full_package_handover.adc_extension: Both directions include prescribed RF-only ADC switching. The wired-to-RF direction now also executes initially discharged SAR/reference charge, iterative recharge feedback, model-observed readiness and finite actual-converter transport; see extended_sar_lifecycle.wired_to_rf. RF-to-wired converter shutdown and an operating-payload round trip remain open.

source_loss_uncertainty.result: Selected 0.25 nH: phase-aligned sampled source-off peak 21.862432 mV; enclosure upper 21.862506 mV. Thus some independent H2D/core origins can exceed 20 mV, not merely a loose upper-bound failure.

Only 3.137494 mV remains for additional bounded disturbance at the worst low threshold.
source_loss_uncertainty.decision: Retain architecture. Do not promise the original 100 ns source-loss response at 20 mV: the witness delays it to 200 ns. Candidate 30 mV +/-5 mV retains 100 ns in this fixture, pending physical offset/noise, transient and payload timing qualification.
source_loss_uncertainty.limits: Steady finite-tone source-off state, selected mismatch/activity, one peak-aligned phase witness and fixed watchdog tick phase. No random noise, residual stop transient, comparator hysteresis/chatter, metastability, physical divider or payload-corruption qualification. The phase-independent amplitude bound is broader than the finite monitor fixture.
source_loss_uncertainty.divided_monitor_result: Peak-aligned settled H2D/core interference produces one upward crossing per 6.4 ns at 15/20 mV, none at 25/30/35 mV. Root counts agree at 4096/8192 samples per period. Across all 64 ideal divider residues, loss is detected within 200 ns at 15/20 mV and 100 ns at 25/30/35 mV. No late requalification on the 2 us fixture. This demonstrates delayed timeout, not permanent false lock.

adc_switching_payload.implementation: converter_dynamics.adc_switching_sources is shared by uncertainty bounds and baseline_envelope.partitioned_host_sources; CORE allocation guard prevents double-counted or excessive mean current.
adc_switching_payload.verification: Independent time-domain gamma-pulse charge integration matches source Fourier coefficients; selected schedule rejects impossible sample period.
adc_switching_payload.result: At 2.4 GHz, negative delay sign, selected package and fixed origins, baseline and 17 mA additional ADC-activity cases both recover the diagnostic payload and converge reference-recharge feedback. Raw bit errors are 22 and 20 respectively; this is not evidence of improved BER.

adc_switching_payload.next_action: Periodic ADC activity now follows mode gating, but actual conversion state, code-dependent event charge, reference-recharge feedback and post-restart payload must still share the transition trajectory. Add uncertainty coverage after joining those consumers.
adc_switching_payload.lifecycle_activity_result: Same 17 mA RF-only periodic ADC spectrum is gated with RF-derived activity in full-package RF-to-wired and wired-to-RF trajectories. H2D/core remain active; full CORE DC reserve retained. At 6.25 ps both sampled rails span approximately [2.6155,3.1679] V; input legs remain below 0.393 V. sar_state_continuation.verification: python3 -m unittest test_baseline_envelope.ConverterDynamicsTests with verification on PYTHONPATH; all five tests pass. Codes, reference recovery segments and final state match exactly.
sar_state_continuation.retained_state: Held I/Q voltage, reference voltage, DAC I/Q voltage, last trial code, absolute end time, RNG state and parameter signature. No implicit reset at call boundary. Acquisition/reset timing and compatible parameters enforced.
sar_state_continuation.limits: Only completed-conversion boundaries. Idle reference forcing remains midpoint-held; no continuous powered-down leakage model, interrupted bit restart, load feedback, external AGC-state serialization or joined mode-recovery payload yet.

retained_sar_retune.demonstrated: Full-package 2.4-to-2.484 GHz retune with host/core and prescribed ADC activity. Retained SAR uses package-derived sample edges, rail and reference, with 1 ns idle integration. Generated recharge segments from both stages, including the gap, drive the same passive network transfer; fixed 1 mA reserve avoids capture-mean accounting. Clock, rail, reference and decisions are rerun together.
retained_sar_retune.result: Three waveform-relaxation passes meet existing residual criteria with unchanged final codes: maximum rail change 9.189 uV, effective input change 0.3014 uV; RMS rail change also below 1 uV. Six pre-gap and fourteen post-gap conversions remain within 1/2 native LSB maximum error. Reference charge residual below 5e-26 C.
retained_sar_retune.limits: Guarded FFT waveform relaxation, not live event-by-event coupling. 125 ps recharge grid and full package 6.25 ps grid; no continuous-time error guarantee. Known baseband tone, fixed phases and selected package; no RF packet or FPGA transport. Deliberate conversion guards replace ready handshake. Other ADC activity remains prescribed periodic current; mid-bit stop, powered-down leakage and uncertainty coverage remain open.
retained_sar_retune.next_action: Connect analog-produced codes and readiness to recovery/transport consumers. Recharge-grid refinement is checked; idle-step sensitivity, phase/package uncertainty and real protocol recovery remain open.

feedback_grid_refinement.result: 125 and 62.5 ps feedback grids both meet stopping criteria in three passes. All twenty conversion words and sample counts are unchanged. Maximum pre/post sample-time differences 0.468/0.162 fs; reference final-state differences below 0.152 nV.
feedback_grid_refinement.scope: Identical 6.25 ps package trajectory, deterministic noise, 1 ns idle integration and one input tone. This verifies only recharge-grid sensitivity; the tiny numerical differences are not physical jitter or accuracy claims.

reference_current_accounting.finding: Legacy load_response subtracts the complete trace average. That is a scoped AC diagnostic, not a causal DC allocation: extending the capture can change earlier forcing. Existing packet feedback results retain that limitation.
reference_current_accounting.decision: Use an explicit fixed current reserve for persistent feedback. With the existing 1 mA recharge limit, model actual positive recharge minus 1 mA already allocated in CORE, including a settled zero-recharge prehistory/tail. Do not add the reserved mean twice. Keep legacy mode explicitly labeled for comparison.
reference_current_accounting.verification: All six ConverterDynamicsTests pass. Fixed-reserve prefix comparison differs by 33 nV at 125 ps grid; zero-recharge DC shift matches analytical I*R. At 250/125/62.5 ps grids, observed prefix residual is 149/33/12 nV: finite FFT approximation remains, not exact causality. Invalid above-limit reserve rejects.
reference_current_accounting.limits: Fixed initial/tail current assumptions, finite FFT guards/grid and reference recharge only. The fixed mode is opt-in and not yet used by older packet campaigns; no silent requalification of those reports.
reference_current_accounting.next_action: Retained-SAR transient now uses explicit 1 mA reserve. Older packet campaigns remain capture-mean-centered controls until rerun with deliberate current ownership; do not silently transfer their verdicts.

finite_sar_transport.demonstrated: Actual retained SAR words enter selected-rate finite transport at conversion completion. Chunked bounded replay preserves frame phase and bit accounting. Unready replay is rejected.
finite_sar_transport.gap: Fresh-frame 178 ns / 379 ns observations enqueue 144 / 336 bits but deliver none before STOP. Extend persistent analog operation through readiness and sustained frames; do not append invented samples or assume away 20 us startup.
finite_sar_transport.scope: Independent warm segment replay, not a joined retune lifecycle or physical timing proof.

package_periodic_continuation.demonstrated: Analytic fixed-source tail retains E*x through 21 us, checked against two explicit time grids and split continuation across three package cases. Actual retune endpoint can be continued without resetting stored state; algebraic interpolation adjustment is reported.
package_periodic_continuation.gap: Passive tail now participates in extended_sar_lifecycle with iterative converter recharge and timed readiness. Physical validity, complete LO edge enumeration, cold startup and uncertainty coverage remain open.

extended_sar_lifecycle.demonstrated: Retained SAR and iterative recharge feedback over 22 us; planned transition and rearm at 0.4 us, readiness at 20.4 us, actual converter delivery without shifting timestamps. RF retune excludes 776 pre-ready samples; 61 eligible samples produce 1120 delivered and 344 discarded bits. The /16 host and /64 converter clocks share observed phase, and transport uses the contract 1024-bit queue (426-bit peak). Stale callbacks and pre-ready payload are rejected; unconverged analog feedback cannot qualify transport.
extended_sar_lifecycle.numerical_check: 125/62.5 ps recharge-grid comparison in extended_lifecycle.feedback_grid_refinement; passive observers independently compared with descriptor state and convolution quadrature.
extended_sar_lifecycle.gap: Powered package, initially discharged converter, prescribed source envelopes and periodic ADC activity. Only selected divided-clock crossings searched. Guarded FFT recharge, not a live causal solver. No full power-up, physical analog-quality READY, interrupted conversion, packet proof or uncertainty-wide verdict. Actual RF clock-loss/recovery is separately recorded below.
extended_sar_lifecycle.supply_validity: Joined transport evidence now requires every rail value used by SAR idle, acquisition and bit-decision equations to meet the existing 2.5 V model floor. The same converter run with a -300 mV local DC offset must be rejected. This is an offline sampled validity gate, not hardware READY or a continuous voltage guarantee.

wired_to_rf.configuration: 2.5 GHz wired package to 2.4 GHz RF, assigned 52 mA mean-load decrease, differential source stop/restart, /64 ADC and /16 host. Reference bias enabled at time zero; no wired-mode ADC apertures.
wired_to_rf.demonstrated: 62.5 ps recharge feedback converges; evaluated converter supply [2.6176603,3.1521787] V. Bounded linear filter-history certificate at 1 MHz becomes valid at 27.8034 us, then the existing reference/supply guard yields READY at 47.8034 us. 1777 pre-ready samples excluded, 74 eligible samples, 1500 delivered and 276 discarded bits. Shared observed host edges; 1024-bit queue peaks at 416 bits.
wired_to_rf.limits: Filter certificate assumes unit-bounded linear input history under fixed coefficients and a 1/1024 normalized residual allocation. SAR receives a known tone; history error is bounded, not injected into a packet. No arbitrary initial filter charge, coefficient-change mapping, saturation, physical bias readiness, preceding wired payload, full round trip, physical sensor, cold supply startup, source phase/package sweep or RF packet. Reference remains biased; no power-saving STOP claim.

clock_loss_package.demonstrated: Retains post-retune passive state into clock loss and return. Source and timing/D2H periodic drives ramp off/on; ADC activity persists through the local completion allocation. Both numerical grids compare crossing counts and monitor detection across divider residues. Exact current results are in the evidence owner.
clock_loss_package.numerical_limit: Selected trajectory uses analytic half-cosine sidebands with retained natural modes and filter states. Three observation grids agree on counts and bisected root times; converter uses these roots. Trapezoidal 12.5/6.25 ps comparison still differs by one 20 mV crossing. Neither sampled agreement nor bisection proves no unbracketed grazing crossing or physical input qualification.
clock_loss_package.transport_support: Explicit bounded D2H event callbacks preserve slot position through clock gaps. Regression has delivered payload before loss, then confirms no host beats during outage while the independent reference watchdog faults with both converter and host clocks absent.
clock_loss_package.gap: Converter recharge and warm payload recovery are joined in clock_loss_recovery. Cold startup, real READY, mid-conversion cancellation, actual host switching currents and arbitrary-phase input qualification remain open.

wired_snapshot_service.demonstrated: 32 concrete 2.5 Gb/s RX streams with declared ±100 ppm clock corners and eight starting phases preserve the payload prefix. Maximum 560 bits, below the selected one-frame snapshot/assigned-CDC bound of 587 and planning allocation of 1024. Missed service produces an actual overflow.
wired_snapshot_service.distinction: The 1099-bit two-frame bound applies a different staging assumption. It is retained for comparison, not silently converted into selected-scheduler evidence.
wired_snapshot_service.gap: Physical FIFO instance/depth, CDC and additional commit latency, recurring stalls, wider protocol clock tolerances/SSC, pad waveform, TX and full PCIe lifecycle remain open.

sar_timing_ownership.cost: Existing converter/control budget; no independent fixed-rate sampling source or new reference pin. Local delay/current/variation and timeout behavior remain unqualified.
sar_timing_ownership.fault_model: Clock-loss package stimulus retains assigned ADC activity for one additional maximum conversion interval after reference shutdown. This is an extended periodic activity envelope, not a rigorous worst-case bound or actual decision-dependent charge or proof of in-flight completion.
sar_timing_ownership.gap: Join actual converter recharge, completion/result validity and stopped D2H/recovery; separately handle explicit cancellation and supply failure.

clock_loss_converter_continuation.demonstrated: Retained filtered reference-target/delay states connect periodic, explicit fault and resumed periodic package intervals. Actual saved SAR charge/noise state continues into 16 conversions, one completing after the source is fully off; no quiet-gap acquisitions. Known-tone maximum error is 2 native LSB.
clock_loss_converter_continuation.unresolved: Guarded FFT approximation retains nonzero frozen-prefix error; not a strictly causal live solver. Physical input noise/hysteresis, arbitrary-phase false-edge immunity, non-reference ADC switching and local completion performance remain unqualified. Joined warm host recovery is reported separately.
clock_loss_converter_continuation.next_action: Warm host recovery is now joined in clock_loss_recovery. Address cold initialization and analog READY, then extend joint uncertainty and complete RF signal-quality coverage.
clock_loss_converter_continuation.analytic_comparison: Selected piecewise exact half-cosine sideband forcing preserves passive and filtered state; bisected roots drive the retained converter. Counts 1031/1027 at 20/30 mV agree across three grids; maximum refined root change 4.8e-17 s. This is numerical agreement, not continuous-root completeness or physical clock qualification. The older trapezoidal one-edge discrepancy remains recorded.
clock_loss_converter_continuation.feedback: Full-history reference recharge is superposed with analytic package forcing, including threshold and delay feedback. Each relaxation reuses the saved SAR state and prior recharge history. 125 ps grid settles but fails 1 uV frozen-prefix bound (1.099 uV); 62.5 ps grid meets it (0.618 uV), settling in two iterations. Identical words and crossing counts; sample-time difference below 1.6e-16 s. Fine result is under feedback_grid_refinement.fine; do not promote the failed coarse result.

clock_loss_recovery.demonstrated: 854 retained conversions through 45 us; finer-grid full-history feedback converges in three iterations with 0.619 uV frozen-prefix error. Shared /16 host and /64 sample phase, actual SAR words, clock-loss fault at 22.10 us, queue discard and stale callback rejection, rearm at 23.10 us, timer/reference READY at 43.10 us and resumed correct payload. 112/144 host words delivered before/after; 368/288 queued bits accounted at STOP.
clock_loss_recovery.limits: Known tone, assigned physical parameters, guarded FFT, ideal reference/supply validity observer and assumed GPIO capture. Reference qualification is enforced but physical sensing is unqualified. Converters continue while payload is stopped; host harmonics are prescribed. No full power-up, full RF bias/filter readiness, arbitrary-phase immunity, interrupted-conversion cancellation or protocol interoperability. Long settled tail brackets needed divided-clock crossings only.

reference_startup.demonstrated: Reference/sample/DAC charge starts at zero; initial reference charging enters retained full-history feedback. First lifecycle aperture reference about 0.271 V; pre-ready codes are excluded. Independent constant-input fixture with stable clocks/3 V rail has 102 native LSB maximum error for 50 ns bias age versus ordinary one-LSB behavior at 200 ns; quarter-current sensitivity invalidates that shorter age.
reference_startup.decision: Reference initialization invalidates readiness. Selected replay attaches ideal model-observed validity from reference segment endpoints/charge steps and evaluated supply. START or latest invalid-to-valid transition starts the existing 20 us guard; loss during active idle or payload faults and requires STOP/new epoch/requalification.
reference_startup.gap: Package supplies remain prepowered. Coarse window does not qualify converter ENOB or RF quality. Sensor accuracy/latency, independent threshold source, physical bias observability, fault-register encoding and budget realization remain unqualified; readiness of RF bias/filter and other analog blocks is not yet joined.
reference_startup.qualification: Assigned coarse 0.98–1.02 V reference window and existing 2.5 V supply floor; connected trace first qualifies at about 105 ns. Successful payload before/after clock recovery retained. Late qualification, active transfer loss and active idle loss are independently exercised by AnalogReadinessTests.

filter_memory.finding: A 20 us timer does not qualify the narrow finite-zero filter. A real sinusoidal prehistory at 500 kHz leaves 0.061749 output for a unit input bound after switch-off; independent companion-state exponential verifies the counterexample. Bounds to the assigned 1/1024 residual allocation are 91.345/54.807/27.403 us at 300 kHz/500 kHz/1 MHz.
filter_memory.decision: Keep generic bandwidth selection. Use configuration-dependent qualification, undisturbed qualified state, a smaller demonstrated history bound, or characterized reset/precharge; warm bias is not sufficient by itself. Existing analog validity ANDs the filter certificate with reference/supply observations before its 20 us guard.
filter_memory.limits: Filter certificate assumes unit-bounded linear input history under fixed coefficients and a 1/1024 normalized residual allocation. SAR receives a known tone; history error is bounded, not injected into a packet. No arbitrary initial filter charge, coefficient-change mapping, saturation, physical bias readiness, preceding wired payload, full round trip, physical sensor, cold supply startup, source phase/package sweep or RF packet. Reference remains biased; no power-saving STOP claim.

packet_extension.demonstrated: Same 500 kHz cutoff and joined selected clock/package/SAR/recharge environment. Both families decode from explicit zero state. A 50 mV cutoff-tone prehistory removed at record start leaves the all-pole case decoding but prevents finite-zero acquisition. Sufficient pre-record decay (12.264 us all-pole, 82.810 us finite-zero) restores the tested request; packet onset is another 4.116 us later. All six cases converge inside the evaluated supply domain.
packet_extension.allocation: Old-history budget is nominal 1/1024 ADC volt after maximum 60 dB PGA gain, rather than 1/1024 of unit filter-input history. Prior tone is specified after early gain/mixing, with fixed removal phase.
packet_extension.decision: Retain the demonstrated all-pole narrowband setting; retain finite-zero selectivity with configuration-specific history qualification. Preserve state across records and reject unmapped coefficient changes.
packet_extension.limits: One seed/phase/offset and prescribed filter-input history. No preceding complete RF/TX/AGC/package trajectory, hardware reset or internal saturation/noise characterization, warm-turnaround/latency guarantee, PER or protocol verdict.

realization_extension.demonstrated: Explicit shared finite-integrator pole surrogate joined to selected moving-rail/clock/SAR/recharge wideband diagnostic. Unchanged coefficients at rho=16 are unstable; rho=32 has 10.40 dB peaking and 8.69% EVM versus ideal 5.99%. Analytic retuning at rho=32 gives 5.87% EVM. +/-10% actual bandwidth retains tested BPSK data but exceeds the 1 dB ripple probe. All five coupled stable cases converge inside the evaluated supply domain.
realization_extension.decision: Retain configurable finite-zero/all-pole filtering; require characterization and finite-bandwidth coefficient compensation before promoting ideal prototype selectivity to a circuit requirement. Extra speed/current alone is not established as the best mitigation.
realization_extension.limits: Identical extra integrator poles, unconstrained real coefficients and no active-device noise, finite DC gain, slew or internal saturation. Ideal DATA boundaries/training, one diagnostic/phase and fixed gain; no real-preamble or high-order-modulation verdict. Illustrative gm/C current costs exclude other amplifier circuitry and do not establish the 16 mA support fit.

noise_and_swing.demonstrated: Twelve voltage-scaled mappings with passband and integrated noise constraints. Preferred higher-Q-first/pole-last mapping costs 4.453/21.535 mA including summing-resistor noise and a separate class-A capacitive-drive hypothesis. Convex dual lower bound rejects the latter within 16 mA. Paired integration capacitance is 972.8/3545.6 pF; plate area is 0.540–1.081/1.970–3.940 mm2 at assigned planning densities. Stronger blocker tone exceeds assigned node headroom. Separate conservative virtual-ground resistor-drive reservations raise the preferred existing-size totals to 7.465/31.819 mA. The favorable 0.600 mm2 plate-constrained candidate totals 7.560 mA including this reservation.
noise_and_swing.decision: Keep preferred mapping conditional. Reject unconditional always-warm 28 mA TX driver fit with the higher-noise filter. Parked/reused bias needs settling and turnaround proof and does not save capacitor area. Headroom alternative costs 12.296/65.351 mA under the same RC/drive hypotheses.
noise_and_swing.limits: No additional current or area granted. Assigned white-noise/device and class-A drive scenarios, sampled frequencies and steady tones. No complete amplifier voltage-noise gain, actual resistor-output-driver implementation, loop stability with integration capacitors, mirror/summer overhead, common mode or colored-noise full RF waveform. Plate-only current-optimum areas are not minimum-area or PDK availability proofs. No GF180 qualification. Resistor drive sums independent branch peaks without reoptimization; it is not a necessary minimum and omits numerator-summer implementation.

joined_wired_electrical.demonstrated: Actual consumed TX bits and word-consistent serializer boundaries drive a rail-dependent linear loaded channel and independent peer CDR. Each recorded case decodes 1300 held-out qualified TX bits with zero errors. Selected local RX loses qualification only during deliberate transition drought. Stress run also exercises wideband RF and retains its adverse quality results.
not_demonstrated: Driver current feedback and continuous supply modulation
Sustained BER or matched all-protocol acceptance
joined_wired_electrical.decision: Keep selected composition provisionally; stop nominal serial expansion and prioritize common power/timing plus RF quality and a representative pad/control lifecycle.

independent_pad_peer.demonstrated: Existing host/device electrical lifecycle migrated: explicit FS peer remains while local selects HS, exposing 0.873/0.798 V instead of fixture 0.4 V. Explicit peer termination restores swing and both-direction stuffed NRZI voltage decode/squelch.
independent_pad_peer.remaining: Join actual recovered sampling (current samples prescribed at peer bit centers), selected transport/storage, command timing, observed chirp negotiation and shared package. Packet delivery is not electrical or deadline acceptance.
independent_pad_peer.packet_transport_evidence: Explicit peer termination now also feeds existing finite packet/host ACK path: eight-byte DATA delivered at either 45 ohm or 15 kohm, but only 45 ohm passes illustrative swing check. Response 337.5 ns at 312.5 Mword/s passes fixture 400 ns; 437.5 ns at 250 Mword/s fails. Both roles covered.
independent_pad_peer.resource_audit: USB packet control now takes 1024-bit playback capacity from selected contract. Peak 36 bits at full host rate, 30 at slower failing rate, for short ACK only. Other adapter FIFO/staging/meta and long-burst storage are not qualified.
independent_pad_peer.transport_gap: TimedRecordReturn/TimedRecordPlayback now use canonical stream_codec.Receiver raw_records/feed_records, delegating the existing bit-event decoder with explicit ordered events. Parser boundary is shared; adapter CDC/scheduling, acquired BehavioralChip traffic, STOP/epoch/reference recovery and actual burst sampling remain separate. Matching capacity/parser does not establish whole transport equivalence.

joined_operating_envelope.decision: Keep the shared architecture provisionally; do not select the 5.36-gain candidate as meeting the power goal. Resolve common local supply and host discontinuity recovery before issuing capability verdicts.
